title: Green Meadows Recreation Center – Conceptual Approval of Proposed Green
text:
Green Meadows Recreation Center – Conceptual Approval of Proposed Green
  Meadows Pavilion Project and Approval of Lease Agreement with Heart of Los
  Angeles Youth, Inc. – Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 9, Section
  15301 [Operation, Repair, Maintenance, Permitting, Leasing, Licensing, or Minor
  Alteration of Existing Public or Private Structures, Facilities, Mechanical
  Equipment, or Topographical Features, Involving Negligible or No Expansion of
  existing or Former Use], Section 15303(E) [Accessory (Appurtenant) Structures
  Including Garages, Carports, Patios, Swimming Pools, and Fences] and Section
  15304(b) [New Gardening or Landscaping, Including the Replacement Of
  Existing Conventional Landscaping With Water Efficient Or Fire Resistant
  Landscaping] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class 1(1),
  Class 3(6), and Class 4(3) of City CEQA Guidelines
